[CREATOR ANNOUCEMENT]

And the stronger side survived. That, simply, is the story.
Hello, everyone. Last week I slowly started to lose the will to continue genning. I thought that a break would solve the issue (and I had that break during Liyue girls series since those were already prepared at the time), but yesterday I'd realized that I've lost it completely and I can't keep going on.
With that said, I am retiring for the time being. I don't want to make bold claims that I'll never come back or be back in a month etc, but know this: at this time I do not see myself returning in the observable future. The account shall remain for the archiving purposes.

I never made a 30K celebration post (and apparently never will), so I'm going to address this here as well.
To those who were a part of this journey, no matter how big or small - I thank you; to all the fans and those who came here recently just to see me gone - I beg your forgiveness, I wish I was stronger.
